title: Termwise products of K-injective complexes on a ringed space

from.place: proof, first step, derived-functor comparison after reconstructing the truncation tower

statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $T$ be a set, and for each $t\in T$ let $I_t^\bullet$ be a K-injective complex [def-sp-kinjective-bridge]. Assume that the product $I^n=\prod_{t\in T}I_t^n$ exists in $\mathcal A$ for every integer $n$ [def-weil-category-product]. Then the termwise product complex $I^\bullet$ is K-injective and represents the product of the objects $I_t^\bullet$ in $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-category-product].

proof.text: Let P be HomologicalComplex.coneOfHasLimitEval of the discrete family. The degreewise limit assumptions imply that every evaluation functor preserves this particular product. Apply the already proved HomotopyCategory.isLimitFanQuotient to obtain the product fan of the quotient complexes in the homotopy category. This theorem assembles chain maps and homotopies degreewise, using only the products of this family.

By CochainComplex.isKInjective_iff_rightOrthogonal, each quotient of I_t belongs to the right orthogonal of acyclic complexes. The proved instance ObjectProperty.isClosedUnderLimitsOfShape_rightOrthogonal and ObjectProperty.prop_of_isLimit show that the product does too. The reverse implication of isKInjective_iff_rightOrthogonal proves that P.pt is K-injective.

Given a fan in the derived category, choose a representative of its point under the essentially surjective Qh. The K-injective Hom bijections lift its legs to the homotopy category. The product constructed in step 1 supplies a lift; applying Qh and composing with the inverse representative isomorphism gives the required derived lift. Lift any candidate via the Hom bijection for the K-injective product, and apply injectivity of the Hom bijections for each factor to prove its equality with the product lift. Transport the resulting limit fan along quotientCompQhIso, then use isLimitMapConeFanMkEquiv to obtain IsLimit for the actual Q.mapCone P.
